first_import_errors: AswError: Line 60: engine is missing End.
coverage.next_step: Match each composite layup and speed/incidence condition to measured displacement and twist with mesh refinement.

continuity_summary.interpretation: Only mutable coverage ledger and geometry implementation differ from prior preparation; all archived source and data bytes remain exact.

primary.author: Peter Earl Dunn
primary.title: Nonlinear stall flutter of wings with bending-torsion coupling

visual_review.findings: Midchord tip deflection in cm; total angle in deg; 1/5/10/15 degree incidence symbols, hollow and solid experimental markers.
Uncoupled experimental flutter boundary exceeds20m/s at root incidence1 and5deg; selected9.0575/10m/s points are comfortably preflutter. No precise boundary redigitization asserted.
Negative layup total angle axis is deg with zero-flow levels1/5/10/15; confirms explicit100x scale used by archived Analysis.m for negative raw T CSV.

primary.redistribution: Original thesis PDF/text and rendered pages are local review evidence; exclude these restricted source contents from published evidence/download archives.

observables.sensor: Single midchord pylon at (.07,0,.558), tip station .558; literal reference axis at leading edge after Xax multiplier0.
observables.RY: Uppercase RY is Earth position; compare sensor.position_earth[1], not anchor displacement.
observables.Psi: Sensor triad heading, current sensor.heading; not elevation or local aerodynamic incidence.
observables.archive_plot: x=sensor V, y=-RY or requested beta-Psi; command !V is indicated speed, not sensor V.
observables.experimental: Time-averaged midchord deflection and total tip angle; both preflutter static and postflutter mean observations are present.
observables.measurement_methods: Hollow video and solid strain-converted values are distinct methods. CSV W/B naming interpretation is supported by primary legend/text, without original digitizer metadata.

physical_model_conflicts.literal_units: EIcc/EInn/GJ/EIcn/EIcs are N m^2; primary laminate plate D is N m, not a drop-in beam property.
physical_model_conflicts.report_sensor_claim: Report describes leading/trailing-edge sensor pair, but literal files contain one midchord sensor.
physical_model_conflicts.shared_internal_name: All three main files use [0_3/90]_s; identify by full path/hash, never name alone.

import_setup.previous_import_record: 4 parsed /1 rejected; malformed horizontal [0_3_90]_S/[03_90]_S.asw has terminal Engine without End.
import_setup.previous_physical_attempt: Nominal40 rejected before any full residual with GroundIntersectionError;80/160 unstarted.
import_setup.current_source: Full clamped endpoint chord on solid wall and parallel wind are admitted by wall_root.py; this is a scoped capability, not arbitrary wall penetration.
import_setup.alternate_warning: Flat model root clamp is interior to its t-domain and its sensor is at root; neither horizontal file is a valid automatic substitute.

lessons_from_ST3_AE3: ST-3 structural states and properties differ from AE-2; do not reuse by layup/name. Primary mode order and report property conflicts need source-specific mapping.

AE-3 demonstrated why measurement convention, finite control amplitude, mesh convergence and physical agreement must remain separate. It is a different wing; no transfer of its numerical/physical pass.
causal_candidates_not_fitted: Frozen versus updated influence setting, historical value unknown
Finite versus ideal wall and atmosphere
runnable_scope: Two declared conditional model conditions across three meshes are well-defined and ready for a separately authorized pilot; exact historical reconstruction and matched experimental validation remain unestablished.
